$comment: The window styles of appearance.chromeStyle: one easy string whose value supplies DEFAULTS for finer knobs. This file is the one source; Swift reads it through generated code (scripts/cmux-next/gen-chrome-styles.py; --check fails when the Swift is stale), and TS, the daemon and other ports read it directly. A key set in cmux.json wins over its style; a Debug Settings tunable wins over both. An absent knob keeps that knob's own default.

chrome.mainPane.curved.meaning: The workspace content is one inset rounded card (the curved main pane).

layout.paneSeparation.meaning: The default of layout.paneSeparation when cmux.json sets none of the pane separation keys.

sidebar.border.meaning: The sidebar's edge line at rest when sidebar.border is unset.

chrome.mainPane.shadeDark.meaning: Black alpha over the chrome around the curved main pane on the separate surface, dark themes.

chrome.mainPane.borderlessStep.meaning: Share of the separate shade the shared surface keeps when no line parts the sidebar from the main pane (unset: 0, one color).

chrome.floatingPanes.meaning: Every pane is its own rounded card, tab strip included, on the shaded chrome: the chrome shade fills the sidebar, the titlebar and every gap, each pane's card is left unshaded (slightly lighter), and the main pane gutter equals the pane padding with no divider gap, so one even gap runs between panes, beside the sidebar and at the window edges.

styles.title: Default
styles.summary: Today's defaults, with the sidebar on the window's color and a hairline on its edge.

styles.title: Card
styles.summary: The curved main pane on one color; a line only between panes, no outline on a lone pane, no shade; a hairline on the sidebar's edge.

styles.title: Card with Outlines
styles.summary: The curved main pane on one color; each pane outlined; a hairline on the sidebar's edge.

styles.title: Flat
styles.summary: No card, one color, edge to edge; a line only between panes; a hairline on the sidebar's edge.

styles.title: Flat with Sidebar Line
styles.summary: Flat, no line between panes (the resize cursor shows a divider), plus a hairline on the sidebar's edge.

styles.title: Bare
styles.summary: No card, one color, no pane or sidebar lines (tab and palette separators stay).

styles.title: Panes
styles.summary: No card, one color; every pane its own outlined rounded card with small gaps; a hairline on the sidebar's edge.

styles.title: Two-Tone
styles.summary: The curved main pane with a soft separate sidebar shade.

styles.title: Floating Panes
styles.summary: Darker window and sidebar; every pane a lighter rounded card, no borders, one even gap on all sides.
